note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. There was no contest in the Irvinestown rural district; the fourteen divisions filled by nomination are listed. No candidates were nominated for Aghamuldowney, Ederney, or Garrison and Lattone, where the sitting members continued to represent the divisions. Filed on 1927-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1927-06-02 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Drumrush is added from the Fermanagh Times, 28 April 1927, p. 6 (7 Nov 2026), which says of Ederney, Aghamuldowney, Garrison and Lattone that 'the former members for these seats will automatically fill them again should they desire to do so'; those four retiring members were deemed re-elected but are not named in the sources read. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Magheracumoney' to Magheraculmoney (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Irvinestown Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Magheraculmoney; the rounds were filed as Magheraculmoney (1924, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1964); Magheracumoney (1927). This round was filed as 'Magheracumoney', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (magheracumoney) answers with a redirect to this one.
